response.original_title: [[Passenger™FAQs]] How Do I Add a Passenger to My Royal Caribbean Cruise Booking?
response.overview: To add a person to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) reservation, you must call Royal Caribbean Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly at 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK), as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a passenger to a Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) online, so you must contact Royal Caribbean customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK). To add another passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) booking, you must call customer service directly 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
